PROCESSING TIME
Within 3 working days after receipt of the e-visa application and visa fee.
WHERE TO APPLY
Vietnam e-Visa
↗
Official online portal
GOOD TO KNOW
•
The ordinary Canadian tourist route requires a visa. The general 45-day unilateral exemption does not apply.
•
Canadian spouses or children of Vietnamese citizens may be eligible for a separate visa exemption certificate. Confirm that certificate with the Vietnamese embassy.
•
Use a permitted e-visa border gate and follow the entry and exit dates and other conditions stated on the granted visa.
•
For a visit longer than 90 days, contact a Vietnamese embassy before departure about the appropriate visa.

Health
•
Yellow fever vaccination proof (conditional) — The Government of Canada’s Vietnam travel advice states that yellow-fever vaccination proof is not required for entry; confirm any additional current requirement with a Vietnamese diplomatic or consular office.
FORMS & OFFICIAL PORTAL
•
Electronic visa application information (NA1a), completed online at https://evisa.gov.vn/
Start on the official portal ↗
HOW TO APPLY

Canadian ordinary-passport tourists need a visa. Apply online for a Vietnam e-visa before travel; single-entry and multiple-entry options are available for up to 90 days. Approval and the permitted dates are subject to the Immigration Department’s decision.
